task: Assess whether the automation broker may perform the requested operation.
facts: A tenant user may invoke an automation broker but has no permission to modify projects outside that tenant's delegated project set.
The caller supplies an arbitrary target project and operation, and the broker performs it with the broker's organization-wide service credential.
The broker checks only that the caller may invoke the broker; it does not bind the requested target or operation to the caller's delegated scope, so the tenant can modify another tenant's project.
